definitions.gloss: president (of a university); secretary-general; head of an organization
definitions.explanation: The person in overall charge of a large organization: the president of some universities ({東京|とうきょう}{大学|だいがく}, {京都|きょうと}{大学|だいがく}), the secretary-general of an international body such as the United Nations ({事務|じむ}{総長|そうちょう}), or the head of certain groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総長|そうちょう}
{総長|そうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The university president gave a speech at the entrance ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧{総長|そうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停戦|ていせん}→停戦：24539_teisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The UN Secretary-General called for a ceasefire.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学長|がくちょう}→学長：29864_gakuchou⟧: university president — the usual title; a few old universities call their head {総長|そうちょう} instead
- ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧: chairman, president (of a company or association)
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧: company president

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧{総長|そうちょう}: secretary-general (UN, NATO)
- ⟦{検事|けんじ}→検事：20788_kenji⟧{総長|そうちょう}: prosecutor-general
- {総長|そうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take office as president
